idea-plugin.name: Firebase Deploy Leak Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Reads firebase.json and names the files your next firebase deploy would publish to the open web

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Firebase Deploy Leak Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 17 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/firebase-deploy-leak-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/firebase-deploy-leak-audit

action.text: Firebase Deploy Leak Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Firebase Deploy Leak Audit on the file in the editor
